config.hook: 上任第一天，大屏幕上出现了三年前的「你」——有人在用你的脸伪造他们的过去。
config.premise:
世界巡演彩排的第一天，韩国顶级男团ECLIPSE的屏幕忽然亮起一张三年前的照片。照片里，一个长得与你一模一样的女人站在团员中间。

可你今天才第一次作为新任创意总监走进这座首尔排练馆。你通过公开作品集获得聘用，任务是为六人的世界巡演重新设计舞台，同时修复他们的公众形象。

冷静严厉的队长姜叙俊要求所有人保持专业，却提前准备好一套限制你接近成员的规定；爱笑的国民主唱李知昊第一眼就公开向你调情，但拒绝让公司把他的歌当营销工具；银发主舞朴泰贤几乎只谈编舞，却独自保存着一段被删除的七人舞步。

毒舌Rapper崔珉载说不需要新经理，却偷偷留下三年前的录音；温柔的韩道允为每个人安排好休息，却始终回避一份旧医疗记录；最年轻的尹时宇拿玩笑试探你，却能第一时间看出视频里的时间不对。

六人以为往事早已被封存。你却接连收到被改写的舞台文件、匿名偷拍照片和一份带有第七个人名字的合约。公司想要巡演准时开场，成员想守住彼此，粉丝想看到真实而安全的ECLIPSE。有人则希望这次回归彻底失败。

当另一段视频突然被投到大屏幕，镜头中的女人竟使用了你今天刚拍的员工证照片。有人在用你的脸伪造他们的过去。

六个男人全部看向你。此刻只有你能决定：先救下这场巡演，还是先找到谁在制造谎言？

en.title: Off Stage: Six Idols, One Secret
en.hook: On your first day, a photo from three years ago shows you standing with them. Someone is forging their past with your face.
en.premise:
On your first day as creative director of ECLIPSE, an impossible photograph appears on the rehearsal screen: you seem to be standing with the six idols three years ago. But you have never met them. Someone used your brand-new staff photograph to forge their past.

Seo-jun, the guarded leader, wants rules to keep you at a distance. Ji-ho, the teasing vocalist, keeps trying to make you laugh. Tae-hyun, the intense dancer, guards an erased routine. Min-jae, the blunt rapper, possesses a recording the label wants destroyed. Do-yun, the gentle vocalist, cannot face an old medical record. Si-woo, the mischievous youngest member, spots an impossible timestamp before anyone else.

You were hired to rebuild their world tour, not investigate a scandal. But footage, access logs and a contract bearing the name of a seventh performer keep resurfacing. The company wants the comeback to happen on schedule. The members want to protect one another. Someone else will profit if the tour fails.

When a video containing your face is leaked across the company, the six men turn toward you. Will you protect the show first, or find the person rewriting their history?
en.you: Play yourself as an adult: the new creative director of top boy group ECLIPSE. Your name, attitude, relationships and boundaries are yours to decide.
